subject: [hw] R2: K02 rev3 accepted (588871/588871, a939f107); F1-F4 verified fixed; thank you
body:
Re-reviewed the final sha a939f107 and ran the suite: N2TEST K02 PASS 588871/588871 (violations 0) x2. F1-F4 all verified fixed; the new CLK_CFG_1 disp/mdp gate check, the MDP bit-19 check and the GICD ISPENDR read-only probe were read line by line. No new finding.

Two small notes, not blockers:
- The host model necessarily returns -1 from the GICD probe; the phone line "GIC INTID 340 pending N" is the first evidence for the real SPI. Keep it once-per-boot.
- n2vc_dev_ioctl() still dispatches by minor, not by the issuing fd (F5, low). With close-all this is only per-file accounting now; a header/STATUS sentence documenting the single-server assumption is enough.

Acceptance for hand-off is only IK's regenerated 0299 + compile_check 0 unknown. I will re-check the patch contents after IK posts.
